layout_findings.source_evidence: The wrapped path skipped cache lookup and rewrite, leaving an older unwrapped BrokenLine list. Empty paragraph returns occurred before cache maintenance.
layout_findings.reproduction: Cache paragraph A unwrapped; optionally lay it out empty; insert a square wrapping frame before three paragraphs and change the third to B; lay out again; remove the frame and incrementally relayout. Only the first remaining block is dirty, so the third is clean and may read stale A breaks.
layout_findings.correction: Retire old cache entries at dirty/full paragraph entry, at the empty paragraph return, and whenever wrapping frames make breaks position dependent.
tests: removing a wrapping frame discards older breaks (empty intermediate: false)
removing a wrapping frame discards older breaks (empty intermediate: true)

layout_findings.source_evidence: Incremental state recorded only model document/section identities. A different engine could accept the same document state and return old pages even when its font or measurement environment differed.
layout_findings.reproduction: Layout two sections with engine A fallbackWidthFactor 0.35. Pass it to engine B factor 0.9, empty dirty set and fromSectionIndex 1. Baseline accepts the foreign layout; a correct fallback must also remeasure section zero.
layout_findings.correction: Attach an opaque per-engine owner token to state. Reject mismatched ownership and discard foreign reuse before the ordinary fallback, resetting fromSectionIndex to zero.
tests: foreign engine reuse remeasures every section with current metrics
